svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: DTSC dual-tier sector charging
svg.desc: One angular sector of a field around a base station, split into an inner and an outer service tier. The inner charger tours its anchors and returns to the base station; the outer charger tours the outer anchors and closes at a rendezvous point on the tier boundary, where the inner charger refuels it by contact. An inset shows the whole field cut into consumption-balanced sectors.
svg.text: Within one sector, the outer charger never returns to base
the outer charger’s long return leg to base:
its partner refuels it at the rendezvous point,
so that leg is paid once per pair, not per charger.
a fixed-point iteration equalises the two tours;
leftover slack becomes extra stay time at the
the field is cut into sectors of
inner charger: BS → anchors → RP → BS
outer charger: closed tour, never reaches BS
Same geometry as Fig. 1 of the paper, restyled; anchors are greedy disk-cover stops that serve several sensors each.
